observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden cabinet table.
The machine has a visible brand/name plate that appears to read 'LION' (exact model not clearly readable).
There is only one sewing machine visible in the photo; no second machine is clearly shown.
The cabinet has drawers/compartments and a foot/pedal area is visible, but no power/operation test is shown.
No close-up of the motor/handwheel label, serial/model plate, or any accessories is shown.

claims.claim: Two lion machine with overlapping table
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only one sewing machine on one cabinet; no second machine or overlapping table is clearly visible.

risks.risk: Whether there are actually two machines (seller claim) vs only one shown.
risks.proof: Send photo(s) showing both machines clearly from the front and side, including the full table/cabinet showing the 'overlapping' setup.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single sewing machine on a cabinet (worst case vs 'two machines').

risks.risk: Whether the machine works (stitching/needle movement) and whether it is complete (needle, bobbin case, presser foot, belt/pulley if applicable).
risks.proof: Send a short video of the machine running and stitching on fabric (or at least hand-crank/foot-pedal movement with needle motion), plus a photo of all included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working / needs service (worst case).

risks.risk: Condition issues: rust, bent needle bar, worn gears/belt, missing parts, or cabinet damage.
risks.proof: Send close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, bobbin/bobbin case, handwheel/gear area, and underside/pedal area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case).

risks.risk: Model/variant mismatch affecting value (exact Lion model not readable).
risks.proof: Send a clear close-up of the model/serial plate on the machine (and any label on the motor/pulley if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable for Lion cabinet sewing machines without confirmed model.

proof_requests: Clear photos showing the second machine (if it exists) and the full 'overlapping table' arrangement.
A video of the machine operating (needle movement + stitching on fabric) or at minimum a demonstration of smooth handwheel/foot-pedal action.
Close-up photos of: needle area/feed dogs, bobbin case, handwheel/gear area, and underside/pedal.
A clear close-up of the model/serial plate so the exact Lion model can be identified.
response.reason: The photo shows only one Lion cabinet sewing machine and does not prove the seller’s 'two machines with overlapping table' claim or working condition. Missing decisive proof prevents a reliable worst-case price.
